# vktVideoCapabilitiesTests

## Overview

`vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp` registers two sibling groups under `video`: `capabilities` for queue, format, codec capability, and encode intra-refresh capability queries, and `formats` for generated video-format compatibility cases ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2297-L2487)).

## Role of File

| Aspect | Evidence-backed description |
|---|---|
| Registration role | Registers `video.capabilities` and `video.formats` through `createVideoCapabilitiesTests()` and `createVideoFormatsTests()` ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2297-L2487)). |
| Implementation role | Implements query instances that validate queue-family video operations, video format properties, and codec capability structures ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L108-L181), [vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L340-L457), [vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L508-L612)). |
| Mustpass evidence | `video.capabilities.*` and `video.formats.*` paths are present in the default video mustpass list ([video.txt](../../../mustpass/main/vk-default/video.txt#L1-L25)). |

## Test Families

- `video.capabilities` iterates `TEST_TYPE_LAST` and uses `getTestName()` to register 25 named query cases, from `queue_support_query` through codec-specific intra-refresh capability queries ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L46-L74), [vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L1891-L1948), [vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2297-L2312)).
- `video.formats` iterates seven codec operations, four image usage bits, a fixed list of Vulkan formats, four chroma-subsampling flags, and three bit-depth flags; non-YCbCr formats are reduced to `ENCODE_SRC` plus monochrome cases before registration ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2315-L2487)).
- Format cases build names from codec, format, usage, chroma subsampling, and bit depth in `formats::getTestName()` ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L1984-L2010)).

## Parameter Dimensions and Observed Values

| Dimension | Observed values or source |
|---|---|
| Capability query types | 25 enum values ending at `TEST_TYPE_LAST` ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L46-L74)). |
| Codec operations for format generation | Decode H.264/H.265/AV1/VP9 and encode H.264/H.265/AV1 ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2319-L2323)). |
| Format-generation usage flags | Decode destination, decode DPB, encode source, and encode DPB ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2390-L2392)). |
| Chroma and bit depth | Monochrome/420/422/444 and 8/10/12-bit flags ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2394-L2403)). |

## Support and Feature Requirements

`VideoCapabilitiesQueryTestCase::checkSupport()` requires `VK_KHR_video_queue`, optionally requires maintenance2 when exposed, and then requires the codec extension and intra-refresh extension appropriate to each test type ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L1750-L1829)). The `formats` support path requires `VK_KHR_video_queue`, requires the codec-specific video extension, and maps unsupported video format query results to `NotSupportedError` where applicable ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2132-L2164), [vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2096-L2116)).

## Verification Methods

- Queue query tests reject empty queue-family lists, non-video codec-operation masks on video queues, zero queue counts, and devices with neither enabled encode nor decode support ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L118-L180)).
- Video format query tests require nonzero returned formats, complete returned counts, written formats, and expected YCbCr or opaque-DPB format behavior ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L374-L456)).
- Capability query tests compare repeated capability queries and validate fields such as declared flag bits, nonzero alignments, coded extent ordering, reference counts, rate-control modes, and codec-specific flags ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L508-L612), [vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L1225-L1274), [vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L1366-L1431)).
- Format compatibility tests cross-check `vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatPropertiesKHR` against format features, image-format properties, and compatible DRM modifiers when reported ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2269-L2288)).

## Test Principles

- Query coverage uses generated names from explicit enum and parameter dimensions instead of hard-coded mustpass entries ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L1891-L1948), [vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2482-L2483)).
- The format generator deliberately prunes non-YCbCr combinations to reduce test count, as stated in the source comment ([vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/video/vktVideoCapabilitiesTests.cpp#L2430-L2441)).

## Notes / Uncertainties

- The `video.formats` hierarchy is large because each direct child is a generated case name from the observed parameter loops and mustpass paths.
